name: zyka-sdk
description: Generate AI videos, images, voice, and use AI apps via the Zyka CLI. 40+ models including Sora, Veo, Kling, WAN, DALL-E, GPT Image, Flux, ElevenLabs, and more.

interface.longDescription: Generate AI videos (Sora, Veo, Kling, WAN, Seedance, Grok, LTX, Aurora, MiniMax), images (DALL-E, GPT Image, Flux, Nano Banana, Kling, Grok, Zyka Helion, Qwen, Seedream, MAI), speech (ElevenLabs, Chatterbox, Qwen3, MiniMax, Fish Audio, Sarvam, Gemini TTS), talking heads, and AI apps (upscale, face swap, captions, dubbing, transcription) from a single CLI. Requires a ZYKA_API_KEY from https://zyka.ai.
capabilities: Generate AI video with Sora, Veo, Kling, WAN, Seedance, Grok, LTX and MiniMax
Generate images with DALL-E, GPT Image, Flux, Nano Banana, Qwen and Seedream
Text to speech with ElevenLabs, Chatterbox, Qwen3, MiniMax and Fish Audio
Create talking-head and lip-synced video from a face image plus audio
Dub video into other languages with HeyGen, ElevenLabs or Sarvam
Transcribe audio and auto-caption video as burn-in MP4 or SRT
Upscale images and video, face swap, virtual try-on and outfit swap
defaultPrompt: Generate a video of a sunset over mountains using WAN
Create an image of a neon cyberpunk city with Nano Banana
Dub this video into Hindi using HeyGen
